name: Self Education for the Construction Workers
nodalDept: BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD
briefDescription: This welfare scheme provides reimbursement of course fees for distance education and an incentive for construction workers obtaining a degree, enhancing their skills.
descriptionMd: The "Self Education for the Construction Workers" scheme, launched by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD, aims to promote educational attainment among construction workers. It provides essential support to enable them to pursue higher education through distance learning, thereby improving their qualifications and career opportunities.
benefitsMd:
- Reimbursement of course fees for distance education.
- Incentive provided for each degree obtained through distance education.
eligibilityMd:
- Applicant must be a construction worker.
- Applicant must be registered with the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD.
- Applicant must be pursuing education through distance learning.
- Applicant must be working towards a degree.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
